# I7MM version 2 cross-implementation vector.
#
# The Rust crate (manifest/) and tools/irix7_manifest.py must both
# reproduce record_hex and wrapped_hex exactly. Version 2 adds the manager
# entry offset and per-export table offsets; the image is 256 bytes so both
# offsets are inside the payload. There is no OS v2 implementation yet, so
# this is an SDK-canonical vector, unlike the decode-only v1 vectors.
#
format=2
name=mesh.transport
version=1.2.3
abi_major=1
abi_minor=0
entry_offset=64
dep_count=2
dep0_name=mesh.codec
dep0_version=1.0.0
dep0_sha256=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
dep1_name=mcp
dep1_version=0.1.3
dep1_sha256=2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222
export_count=1
export0_interface=irix7.mesh.transport
export0_version=1
export0_offset=128
image_
record_
record_len=164
wrapped_
wrapped_len=436
wrapped_sha256=e8b7da6943af0f46b0d566f38ff2c1886a3d19e775b15c758caaabd796339761
